text:
olivia: Quick sync: planning a controlled cutover for traffic-slice alpha -> beta in us-east at 05:00 UTC. Goal: verify routing stability and verify fallbacks. Plan: 0.25% -> 2% -> 8% -> 25% with holds 3m/6m/10m/15m.

kevin: Sounds good. Are we pinning runtime versions?

olivia: Yes pin to `inference-runtime@2026-05-01` for cohort. Rollout payload will be applied via `ffctl`. Auto-rollback triggers: p95>250ms or error_rate delta >1.2%.

olivia: rollout payload (inline): `strategy: staged, pin: inference-runtime@2026-05-01, steps: [0.25%,2%,8%,25%], holds: [3m,6m,10m,15m], rollback_on: [p95>250, err_delta>1.2]`

kevin: Ops: can we schedule a small prefix-cache preload 10m before step-1 and a synthetic 1-min traffic replay 5m before step-1 to capture fresh baselines? Also enable header `X-Traffic-Slice=alpha-beta` for tracing.

infra-bot: Preload job `prefix-preload/alpha-beta` scheduled at 2026-04-09T04:50:00Z. Synthetic replay `replay/alpha-beta` scheduled at 2026-04-09T04:55:00Z. Preflight checks passed: capacity ok, no maintenance.

deploy-bot: Rollout queued: `ffctl apply traffic-slice --env=us-east` JobID: ts-60211 ETA 2026-04-09T05:00:00Z. It will annotate release notes in the rollout link.

kevin: During ramp, if auto-backoff happens, deploy-bot will step down one tier, extend hold +12m, and attempt one auto-recover. If the step remains unhealthy, escalate to oncall for manual rollback.

deploy-bot: Confirmed. Auto-backoff policy enabled. On escalation will open incident stub and page oncall. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/traffic-slice-cutover

oncall-bot: Oncall rota will be paged on escalation. Current oncall: kevin.

olivia: Final checklist: pin runtime, set staged payload, schedule preload+replay, enable headers/traces, set alert thresholds, confirm oncall. Starting in ~30m. Will post heartbeat at every holdpoint.

kevin: SGTM. If manual rollback needed I'll run `ffctl rollback traffic-slice --to=0%` and coordinate postmortem.

olivia: Thanks team. Prefer early rollback on odd signals to minimize blast radius.
